<Aside type="note">
  Community listings are not maintained by the Aptos Core Team. Prefer the
  official references on this site when they cover the same topic.
</Aside>

## Official references

Lookup pages that belong in the Reference section of these docs:

- [Glossary](/network/glossary) — terms used across Aptos docs.
- [Error codes](/build/smart-contracts/error-codes) — common VM and Move abort codes.
- [Transaction payloads and BCS](/network/blockchain/transaction-payloads) — payload variants and encoding.
- [Indexer GraphQL reference](/build/indexer/indexer-api/indexer-reference) — hosted indexer tables and fields.
- [REST API reference](/rest-api) — fullnode OpenAPI reference generated from [`/aptos-spec.json`](/aptos-spec.json).
- [AIPs](/build/aips) — developer-facing Aptos Improvement Proposal FAQs.

Move language and framework books (mdBook, hosted outside this site):

- [Move Book](https://aptos-labs.github.io/move-book/) — Move language reference.
- [Aptos Framework Book](https://aptos-labs.github.io/framework-book/) — `aptos-framework`, `aptos-stdlib`, `move-stdlib`, and token-object packages.

Network explorers and hosted developer services:

- [Aptos Explorer](https://explorer.aptoslabs.com/) — accounts, transactions, and validators.
- [Geomi](https://geomi.dev/) (formerly Aptos Build) — API keys, Gas Station, and no-code indexing.
- [AI tools](/build/ai) — Aptos MCP, Agent Skills, and LLMs.txt.

## Move learning resources

### Tutorials

- [Aptos Learn](https://learn.aptoslabs.com) — Learn how to build on the Aptos Blockchain with various tutorials.

### Videos

- [Aptos Dev YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@aptosdev) — Learn about how to build on the Aptos Blockchain with various videos.

### Examples

- [Move By Examples](https://github.com/aptos-labs/move-by-examples) — A collection of Move examples.
- [Daily Move](https://github.com/aptos-labs/daily-move) — A collection of short Move examples illustrating Aptos features.
- [Aptos-Core Move Examples](https://github.com/aptos-labs/aptos-core/tree/main/aptos-move/move-examples) — A collection of Move examples actively tested in CI in the Aptos Core repository.

## Community developer tools

- [Surf](https://github.com/ThalaLabs/surf) — Generated TypeScript interfaces and React hooks for Aptos smart contracts.
- [Revela](https://revela.verichains.io/) — Move bytecode decompiler. The Aptos CLI can also decompile with `aptos move decompile --decompiler-version v2`.

## Data and analytics

SQL datasets, dashboards, and RPC vendors are listed on [Data Providers](/build/apis/data-providers).
